successors.name: Commonwealth of Australia
successors.text: Western Australia, which 'on 1 January 1901, following a proclamation by Queen Victoria' joined the Commonwealth

ledger.x: 1829: the Swan River Colony is established, claiming all of Australia west of New South Wales.
1832: the Swan River Colony is renamed Western Australia.

wars.name: Pinjarra massacre
wars.outcome: The Pinjarra massacre 'occurred on 28 October 1834 in Pinjarra, Western Australia' (Pinjarra massacre page, lead and infobox).

certainty.note: The only land border is the 129th meridian east, fixed by the 1825 extension of New South Wales (Territorial evolution of Australia) and unchanged to 1901; it is a legal line, surveyed on the ground only much later.

sources.title: Colony of Western Australia (History of Western Australia)
